achievement.brief: A column of tanks bursts through a smoky gap in a hill line, infantry cheering and following behind, dust and sunlight.

advisor_card.brief: A grey-haired chief of staff in a decorated general's uniform, standing over a large map table with a pointer, stern focused expression, dim war-room lamps behind him.

agency_logo.brief: A round emblem of a single open eye with a radiating gold iris inside a pyramid-free triangle, on a black disc with a thin gold rim.

bop_side.brief: A tall standard bearing a large anchor wrapped in thick rope, the navy side in a rivalry between navy and army for budget.

building.brief: A timber-and-stone cable car station clinging to an Italian Alpine ridge, steel cables rising into clouds, snow-dusted fir trees and a festive mood.

commander_portrait.brief: A Finnish colonel in a white winter camouflage smock and fur-flapped cap, frosted moustache, alert steady eyes, birch forest and falling snow behind him.

commander_trait.brief: A pair of wooden skis crossed with two poles, a winter warfare specialist, bold simple shape.

counter_large.brief: Bold black silhouette of a quad-barrelled anti-aircraft gun pointing steeply skyward on a rotating pedestal with a small gunner seat.

counter_small.brief: Four short black gun barrels fanned upward from a squat round mount, bold wide shapes with flat tops.

decision.brief: A blacksmith's anvil with a heavy hammer resting across it, a few glowing sparks, one bold object. Bold two-colour carved print.

decision_category_icon.brief: A striped border post and a lowered barrier gate with coils of barbed wire, grim emblem of border conflicts. Bold two-colour carved print.

division_emblem.brief: A brown bear rearing on its hind legs with claws raised, set on a pale green wide shield with a dark border.

doctrine.brief: A line of alpine troops roped together climbing a snowy ridge with packs and ice axes under a huge sky, Italian mountain doctrine.

faction_logo.brief: A round emblem of two crossed swords inside a laurel wreath, in steel grey and gold on a deep red disc, formal and martial.

flag.brief: A fictional flag with a plain crimson field, a large golden five-pointed star at the centre encircled by a ring of golden wheat ears, and a thin golden border.

focus.brief: Diplomacy: two envoys shaking hands under two invented national flags.

gui_texture.brief: Deep blue technical paper with a faint pale grid of fine lines and a thin white double border, no drawings.

idea_concern.brief: A rolling mill where a glowing slab of armour plate is pulled between huge rollers, sparks scattering, steelworkers in the glare, Czech mood of power.

idea_spirit.brief: Swiss mountain villagers with rifles and a cowbell standing watch above a snowy pass, calm and watchful readiness.

leader_portrait.brief: A cheerful American president in his fifties, pinstripe suit, wire-rimmed glasses, hopeful chin-up smile, limestone portico and a bright sky behind, festive optimistic mood. An invented person: the face, the name and the likeness are fictional and must not resemble any real historical figure.

mio_department.brief: A thick glowing steel armour plate emerging from heavy rolling mill rollers, sparks flying, Yugoslav steelworks in grim industrial mood.

mio_policy.brief: Two pairs of hands passing rolled blueprints to each other across a table in front of two different factory windows, patent sharing, friendly mood.

modifier_stat_icon.brief: A single-engined fighter plane seen from above with swept wings, and a bold arrow rising above it.

news_event.brief: A huge crowd of travellers with suitcases fills a station under an iron-and-glass roof, steam clouds drifting, porters pushing trolleys, a soldier embracing his sweetheart, tense bustle.

officer_corps_spirit.brief: A Hungarian hussar officer in a braided jacket and plumed shako on a prancing horse, festive and proud cavalry pageantry.

operation_icon.brief: A neatly folded officer uniform tunic with a cap and polished boots on a wooden chair, disguise prepared for infiltration.

operation_picture.brief: A technician in an attic drills into plaster to place a hidden microphone wire, tools laid neatly on a cloth, a single bare bulb overhead.

personal_trait.brief: A single fat coin purse tied at the neck with a few coins spilling out, a corrupt leader, soft flat gouache look.

raid.brief: A neat pyramid of artillery shells stacked behind sandbags with a thin trail of smoke curling from the top, grainy sepia ink sketch of an Italian depot.

report_event.brief: Pickers in straw hats strip coffee cherries on a steep Brazilian hillside plantation, sacks piled beside mule carts, an overseer on horseback watching, warm hazy afternoon.

special_project_icon.brief: A half-built aircraft carrier on a Japanese shipyard slipway wrapped in scaffolding and cranes, flat deck stretching into morning mist, tiny workers below, proud mood.

state_modifier.brief: A coal mine headframe with a spinning winding wheel and a line of coal tubs on a rail, black slag heap behind.

super_event.brief: Two delegations face each other across a table inside a wood-panelled railway carriage in a forest clearing, rain streaking the windows, grim and formal, no flags.

technology.brief: A Soviet medium tank with sloped armour, wide tracks and a long gun, shown in side view, slightly mud-splashed, without markings.
